faults.title: Air-conditioning pipe failure
faults.description: A pipe in the first-generation Juke's air-conditioning system can fail and stop cold air reaching the cabin. Test the system and have leaks located before replacing parts or simply recharging it.

faults.title: Turbo-related stalling recall on early cars
faults.description: Some Jukes built from March 2010 to November 2011 were recalled for a turbo issue that could stall the engine. Check the VIN and confirm the recall repair was completed on an affected car.
